dog.description_text:
🎃🐾 MEET MOWGLI! 🐾🎃
This handsome little guy is Mowgli, and he’ll be looking for his forever family at our Pumpkins & Pups Adoption Event! ❤️
🐶 Male
🎂 11 weeks old
🐾 Mixed Breed
⚖️ Expected adult size: approximately 30–40 lbs.
Mowgli didn’t exactly get the beginning every puppy deserves. He and his siblings were found abandoned, but thankfully, their story didn’t end there. ❤️
Now safe in rescue, Mowgli is getting the chance to simply be what he should have been all along—a happy, pup
dog.name: MOWGLI
